description: Exact all in price for one home and date range, from the same engine as the site's booking form: nightly subtotal, any discount, cleaning fee, pet fee, 7% sales tax plus surtax, 6% tourist development tax, total, and the payment schedule (20% deposit at booking and the balance 45 days before check in, or full payment when check in is 45 days away or less; returning guests with their returning guest code pay no deposit and no pet fee). Errors (each with a one sentence message): UNKNOWN_PROPERTY, BAD_DATES, PAST_DATES, BEYOND_HORIZON (last night after 2027-12-31; carries lastBookableDate), MIN_NIGHTS, UNAVAILABLE, OVER_CAPACITY (carries maxGuests). A request holds nothing. Dates are reserved when the deposit or full payment clears. Check in 3:00 PM, check out 10:00 AM. Read only; nothing is booked or held.

code.description: Discount code, only if the guest already has one

dog.description: True if the guest brings a dog (adds the pet fee). The REST endpoint calls this parameter pets; this server accepts pets as an alias.

guests.description: Number of guests, counted against the home's capacity

property.description: happy-island-cottage = Happy Island Cottage, sleeps 6; happy-turtle-a = Happy Turtle A, sleeps 5; happy-turtle-b = Happy Turtle B, sleeps 4

name: get_quote
title: Get an exact quote
